hotels.name: Soneva Fushi
hotels.verdict: Consistently ranked among the top 10 hotels on Earth for barefoot privacy, astronomy observatory dining, and organic chocolate & ice cream rooms.
hotels.standout: No-news, no-shoes barefoot eco-luxury with overwater villas featuring water slides & an open-air jungle cinema
hotels.watchOut: Ultra-premium dining and seaplane pricing — plus rustic-chic timber design won't suit fans of glossy marble

hotels.name: Soneva Jani
hotels.verdict: The quintessential bucket-list overwater villa resort, praised across YouTube for unmatched villa size and dreamlike lagoon clarity.
hotels.standout: Iconic retractable bedroom roofs for stargazing and curved water slides straight into a 5.6km turquoise lagoon
hotels.watchOut: One of the most expensive resorts in the Indian Ocean — best booked with Soneva Unlimited all-inclusive

hotels.name: Cheval Blanc Randheli
hotels.verdict: Widely considered the pinnacle of polished French haute-couture hospitality in the Maldives.
hotels.standout: Jean-Michel Gathy cathedral-ceiling villas, bespoke yellow seaplane, and Le 1947 Michelin-caliber fine dining
hotels.watchOut: Strict LVMH luxury pricing with zero loyalty-points redemptions and high transfer surcharges

hotels.name: Waldorf Astoria Maldives Ithaafushi
hotels.verdict: YouTube points reviewers crown this Hilton's #1 flagship redemption in the world, with massive private-pool villas.
hotels.standout: 45-minute luxury yacht arrival from Malé (no seaplane wait!), 11 dining venues including Terra treetop pods, and huge Hilton points value
hotels.watchOut: Yacht transfer costs ~£800+ per adult even on points stays, and man-made islands have less natural reef than Baa Atoll

hotels.name: One&Only Reethi Rah
hotels.verdict: A timeless Maldives icon praised for impeccable staff polish, beach variety, and huge family-friendly beach villas.
hotels.standout: 12 private white-sand beaches across a sweeping octopus-shaped island, legendary celebrity privacy, and luxury yacht transfers
hotels.watchOut: Expansive layout requires buggies or bicycles everywhere; house reef is modest compared to remote outer atolls

hotels.name: JOALI Maldives
hotels.verdict: Design-forward Maldives luxury island resort known for interactive art installations and Jadugar butler service.
hotels.standout: Interactive art installations across the island, rose-gold villa finishes, and dedicated Jadugar butler service
hotels.watchOut: 45-minute seaplane transfer from Malé; tranquil design-led resort rather than nightlife-focused

hotels.name: The St. Regis Maldives Vommuli Resort
hotels.verdict: A perennial Bonvoy bucket-list stay celebrated for bold manta-ray architecture and dramatic sunset views.
hotels.standout: Architectural Whale Bar sunsets, Iridium hydrotherapy Blue Hole pool, and classic St. Regis Butler care on Marriott points
hotels.watchOut: Seaplane fees and breakfast/dining costs are steep, and some reviewers note beach erosion on parts of the island

hotels.name: Velaa Private Island
hotels.verdict: Ultra-private Noonu Atoll island resort with private golf academy, snow room spa, and extensive wine cellar.
hotels.standout: Private golf academy, snow room spa, extensive wine cellar, and ultra-private island footprint
hotels.watchOut: Ultra-luxury nightly rates and seaplane transfer requirements

hotels.name: Patina Maldives, Fari Islands
hotels.verdict: Loved by design-forward reviewers for effortless speedboat access from Malé and standout contemporary architecture.
hotels.standout: Studio MK27 minimalist villas, James Turrell Skyspace light pavilion, and Fari Marina Village dining variety
hotels.watchOut: Sleek contemporary island vibe rather than traditional thatched-roof tropical Robinson Crusoe feel

hotels.name: Kudadoo Maldives Private Island
hotels.verdict: Virtually universal 5-star praise for completely eliminating check-out bill anxiety in the Maldives.
hotels.standout: True 'Anything, Anytime, Anywhere' all-inclusive — unlimited spa treatments, private excursions, champagne & fine dining
hotels.watchOut: Adults-focused intimate 15-villa island with high upfront nightly rate (though zero surprise bill at checkout)

hotels.name: NIHI Sumba
hotels.verdict: Repeatedly named the best hotel in the world for transformative adventure luxury and authentic Sumba community impact.
hotels.standout: Swimming with wild Sandalwood horses at sunrise, world-famous Occy's Left surf wave, and all-inclusive cliffside villas
hotels.watchOut: Requires a domestic flight from Bali plus a 90-minute overland transfer — worth at least 4 nights

hotels.name: Amankila
hotels.verdict: Considered by Amanjunkies and hotel critics alike as one of Asia's purest architectural masterpieces.
hotels.standout: Ed Tuttle's legendary three-tiered infinity pool cascading toward the Lombok Strait and private black-sand beach club
hotels.watchOut: Quiet East Bali location is 90+ minutes from Seminyak/Canggu nightlife — pure serene escapism

hotels.name: Bulgari Resort Bali
hotels.verdict: High-glamour clifftop privacy with dramatic sunset drama, though value-conscious reviewers compare it closely against The Ungasan & Ritz-Carlton.
hotels.standout: Dramatic 150m cliffside funicular to a secluded beach, Il Ristorante Niko Romito dining, and sleek Italian-Balinese stone villas
hotels.watchOut: Does NOT participate in Marriott Bonvoy points redemptions; cliffside ocean is too rough for swimming most days

hotels.name: Capella Ubud, Bali
hotels.verdict: Bill Bensley-designed tented rainforest sanctuary suspended above the Keliki Valley near Ubud.
hotels.standout: Whimsical 19th-century explorer luxury tents with private saltwater pools set directly in the Ubud rainforest
hotels.watchOut: Steep jungle stairs, open-air rainforest environment, and tented canvas walls rather than sealed glass rooms

hotels.name: Four Seasons Resort Bali at Sayan
hotels.verdict: Frequently compared head-to-head against Mandapa Ubud — slightly more approachable rates with iconic architectural arrival.
hotels.standout: Iconic floating lotus-pond rooftop arrival over the Ayung River gorge and world-renowned wellness & Balinese culinary classes
hotels.watchOut: Older than Mandapa next door in some classic suite finishes, though regularly refreshed and deeply serene

hotels.name: Raffles Bali
hotels.verdict: Quietly earning the highest verified guest scores in southern Bali, outscoring older Jimbaran neighbors on room freshness.
hotels.standout: Just 32 ultra-spacious hillside pool villas with panoramic Jimbaran Bay views, Secret Cave candlelit dining, and Raffles Wellbeing Butlers
hotels.watchOut: Intimate scale means fewer large resort venues — built for quiet romance over bustling beach-club energy

hotels.name: Alila Villas Uluwatu
hotels.verdict: A modern design classic and top World of Hyatt luxury redemption in Bali.
hotels.standout: Instagram-famous cantilevered wooden birdcage cabana over the Indian Ocean, minimalist WOHA design, and strong Hyatt points value
hotels.watchOut: Open-air breeze corridors mean occasional insects and no direct beach access (steep cliff staircase)

hotels.name: Amandari
hotels.verdict: Revered by repeat Bali luxury travelers for soulfulness and whisper-quiet service.
hotels.standout: Modelled after a traditional Balinese village overlooking the Ayung gorge — timeless peace and unmatched cultural immersion
hotels.watchOut: Traditional thatched-roof heritage suites feel classic rather than flashy ultra-modern

hotels.name: COMO Shambhala Estate
hotels.verdict: Bali's benchmark holistic wellness sanctuary, frequently paired with COMO Uma Canggu for a bush-and-beach trip.
hotels.standout: Sacred riverfront spring pools, resident Ayurvedic & holistic wellness specialists, and deeply restorative jungle residences
hotels.watchOut: Built around wellness and healthy cuisine — less suited to late-night cocktails or beachfront lounging

hotels.name: Bawah Reserve
hotels.verdict: Often called 'Indonesia's answer to the Maldives' with pristine untouched lagoons and zero crowds.
hotels.standout: Reachable only by private amphibious seaplane from Batam/Singapore — 6 untouched islands, 13 beaches, and all-inclusive dining & spa
hotels.watchOut: Multi-step transfer from Singapore (ferry + seaplane) adds travel planning time

hotels.name: Capella Bangkok
hotels.verdict: Named #1 in The World's 50 Best Hotels; critics rave about the seamless riverfront villas and legendary complimentary aperitivo hour.
hotels.standout: Every suite faces the Chao Phraya River, two-Michelin-star Côte by Mauro Colagreco, and extraordinary Capella Culturist service
hotels.watchOut: Next door to Four Seasons Bangkok — slightly smaller resort pool footprint in exchange for ultra-intimate 101-room privacy

hotels.name: Mandarin Oriental, Bangkok
hotels.verdict: One of the most storied grand hotels on Earth — universally praised for old-world Thai hospitality perfection.
hotels.standout: Two-Michelin-star Le Normandie, legendary Authors' Lounge afternoon tea, and teakwood shuttle boats across the Chao Phraya
hotels.watchOut: Smart-casual dress code enforced strictly across dining rooms and lobby; historic wing is classic rather than minimalist

hotels.name: Amanpuri
hotels.verdict: The flagship property that invented modern barefoot luxury in 1988 and still sets Thailand's benchmark.
hotels.standout: Private coconut-palm peninsula, iconic black-tiled infinity pool, and one of Phuket's most secluded white-sand coves
hotels.watchOut: Classic 1988 pavilion architecture commands ultra-premium Aman pricing

hotels.name: Six Senses Yao Noi
hotels.verdict: Beloved across luxury travel YouTube for jaw-dropping sunrise views and warm GEM butler service.
hotels.standout: The Hilltop Pool framing Phang Nga Bay's dramatic limestone sea stacks — arguably Thailand's most famous view
hotels.watchOut: Beach is tidal and modest; rustic timber villas prioritize eco-luxury charm over sleek air-conditioned gloss

hotels.name: Soneva Kiri
hotels.verdict: Thailand's purest remote barefoot-luxury hideaway with untouched turquoise bays.
hotels.standout: Private Soneva plane from Bangkok, iconic suspended Treepod dining in the rainforest canopy, and colossal pool villas
hotels.watchOut: Private plane schedule adds ~£400/person and limits spontaneous transfers

hotels.name: Rosewood Phuket
hotels.verdict: Phuket's sleekest contemporary beachfront resort with rave reviews for family suites and design.
hotels.standout: Secluded 600m beachfront sanctuary minutes from Patong yet worlds away, with huge private plunge pools and Ta Khai village seafood
hotels.watchOut: Emerald Bay beach is shallow/rocky at low tide, making pool lounging better than ocean swimming at certain hours

hotels.name: Raffles Singapore
hotels.verdict: Singapore's undisputed grand dame, combining heritage glamour with spotless modern refurbishment.
hotels.standout: Immaculately restored 1887 colonial landmark, all-suite butler service, Long Bar Singapore Slings, and La Dame de Pic dining
hotels.watchOut: Courtyard public arcades draw daytime tourists — suite wings remain strictly keycard-private

hotels.name: Capella Singapore
hotels.verdict: Singapore's finest true resort escape when you want tropical calm alongside city convenience.
hotels.standout: 30 acres of peacock-roaming rainforest gardens on Sentosa, tiered cascading pools, and serene private-pool villas
hotels.watchOut: Requires a 15–20 minute taxi from downtown Marina Bay / Orchard Road

hotels.name: Marina Bay Sands
hotels.verdict: A classic Split-Verdict icon: unbeatable skyline pool bucket list, though luxury critics note its mega-resort crowds vs. Raffles.
hotels.standout: Newly renovated Paiza & Sands Collection suites plus exclusive guest-only access to the 57th-floor Skypark infinity pool
hotels.watchOut: Massive 1,850+ room casino-resort scale means crowded check-in lobbies and busy poolside hours — book the newly refurbished suites only

hotels.name: Amanoi
hotels.verdict: Regularly hailed as Vietnam's finest luxury resort and one of Aman's greatest coastal properties.
hotels.standout: Clifftop infinity pool perched above Vinh Hy Bay inside Núi Chúa National Park, private lakeside spa houses, and serene minimalism
hotels.watchOut: Remote 75-minute drive from Cam Ranh airport — designed for deep disconnection

hotels.name: Aman Tokyo
hotels.verdict: Tokyo's ultimate architectural urban sanctuary blending ryokan minimalism with skyscraper drama.
hotels.standout: Soaring 30m washi-paper shoji lobby 33 floors above Tokyo, granite deep-soaking furo tubs, and a 30m skyline indoor pool
hotels.watchOut: Nightly rates have surged above £1,400+; lobby lounge can get lively with afternoon tea visitors

hotels.name: Rosewood Hong Kong
hotels.verdict: Widely voted Asia's premier ultra-luxury city hotel with jaw-dropping marble bathrooms and harbour views.
hotels.standout: Sweeping Victoria Harbour views, Tony Chi residential interiors, DarkSide cocktail bar, and Manor Club executive lounge perfection
hotels.watchOut: Located on the Kowloon side (a short ferry/tunnel from Central); high F&B pricing

hotels.name: The Upper House
hotels.verdict: Beloved by seasoned luxury travelers for effortless, paperless service and calm above busy Hong Kong.
hotels.standout: Andre Fu's tranquil zen design, complimentary Maxi Bar in every room, huge limestone tubs, and Salisterra skyline dining
hotels.watchOut: No swimming pool on property (guests focus on serenity, gym & spa instead)

hotels.name: Park Hyatt Kyoto
hotels.verdict: Arguably the most coveted luxury points hotel in Japan — intimate 70-room hillside guesthouse atmosphere.
hotels.standout: Steps from Kiyomizu-dera & Ninenzaka lantern lanes, Yasaka Pagoda sunset terrace views, and phenomenal World of Hyatt points value
hotels.watchOut: Extremely difficult award availability and cash rates often exceed £1,200/night in cherry blossom/autumn seasons

hotels.name: Aman Kyoto
hotels.verdict: A transcendent forest-bath sanctuary offering total quiet in busy Kyoto.
hotels.standout: Hidden inside 80 acres of ancient moss-covered secret gardens with open-air mineral onsen hot springs and Kerry Hill pavilions
hotels.watchOut: 25-minute taxi from central Kyoto sights; eye-watering nightly pricing

hotels.name: The Peninsula Tokyo
hotels.verdict: A rock-solid classic Tokyo luxury choice with prime Ginza walkability.
hotels.standout: Direct views over the Imperial Palace Gardens, custom Rolls-Royce fleet, and classic Japanese-meets-heritage service polish
hotels.watchOut: Room tech and decor feel slightly more traditional than newer Janu/Bulgari Tokyo openings

hotels.name: Janu Tokyo
hotels.verdict: Tokyo's hottest luxury opening with standout gym/spa facilities and crisp Jean-Michel Gathy design.
hotels.standout: 4,000 sqm wellness & boxing/hydrotherapy sanctuary, Tokyo Tower views, and 8 vibrant restaurants at half Aman Tokyo's rate
hotels.watchOut: More social and energetic than Aman — less hushed minimalism

hotels.name: HOSHINOYA Kyoto
hotels.verdict: One of Japan's most atmospheric luxury ryokan escapes, stunning during autumn foliage.
hotels.standout: Private wooden riverboat arrival up the Oi River gorge, tatami heritage pavilions, and Michelin-starred kaiseki dining
hotels.watchOut: Remote boat-access logistics mean dining on property or planning exits around boat times

hotels.name: Atlantis The Royal
hotels.verdict: Architectural landmark mega-resort on Palm Jumeirah featuring cantilevered sky pools and celebrity-chef dining.
hotels.standout: Cloud 22 cantilevered sky pool, celebrity-chef dining venues, and Aquaventure waterpark access
hotels.watchOut: Large resort scale feels lively and high-energy rather than intimate; Cloud 22 cabanas carry extra charges

hotels.name: Jumeirah Burj Al Arab
hotels.verdict: A classic bucket-list icon: reviewers love the service and SAL pool while noting the bold retro-opulent room styling.
hotels.standout: Every room is a huge two-story duplex with 24/7 butler service, Hermès amenities, and the SAL infinity pool terrace
hotels.watchOut: Maximalist 1999 gold-and-velvet interiors divide modern luxury reviewers — high price for nostalgic opulence vs. Bulgari Dubai

hotels.name: Bulgari Resort Dubai
hotels.verdict: Unanimously rated by critics as Dubai's chicest, quietest ultra-luxury resort — the exact opposite of mega-resort crowds.
hotels.standout: Private seahorse-shaped island with Dubai's only Bulgari Yacht Club, two-Michelin-star Il Ristorante, and understated Milanese calm
hotels.watchOut: No Marriott Bonvoy points redemptions and rates rarely drop below £1,000/night

hotels.name: One&Only The Palm
hotels.verdict: A serene low-rise haven widely preferred by couples seeking romance over Dubai's skyscraper towers.
hotels.standout: Boutique 94-key Andalusian-Moorish oasis on the Palm's quietest tip, Guerlain Spa, and 3-Michelin-star STAY by Yannick Alléno
hotels.watchOut: 25-minute drive down the Palm crescent (though the private resort boat to One&Only Royal Mirage makes transfers fun)

hotels.name: Jumeirah Al Naseem
hotels.verdict: Consistently considered the best all-around modern beachfront hotel in Dubai for service, food, and views.
hotels.standout: Fresh modern beachfront rooms staring straight at the Burj Al Arab, turtle rehabilitation lagoon, and 50+ Madinat Jumeirah restaurants
hotels.watchOut: Popular with families during UK school holidays — book Summersalt Beach Club or adult pool cabanas for quiet

hotels.name: Six Senses Zighy Bay
hotels.verdict: One of the Middle East's most dramatic luxury escapes, combining fjord mountains with barefoot Oman serenity.
hotels.standout: Optional tandem paraglide arrival straight onto the private fjord beach, stone-walled pool villas, and Sense on the Edge cliff dining
hotels.watchOut: 2-hour scenic drive + border crossing from Dubai airport; summer months (Jun–Aug) are intensely hot

hotels.name: Al Maha, a Luxury Collection Desert Resort
hotels.verdict: A legendary Marriott points sweet spot and bucket-list desert wildlife luxury experience.
hotels.standout: All-inclusive meals + two daily desert activities (falconry, camel sundowners, dune drives) and private heated pools visited by wild Arabian oryx
hotels.watchOut: Classic Bedouin tented interiors feel slightly traditional; children under 10 are not permitted

hotels.name: Emirates Palace Mandarin Oriental
hotels.verdict: A jaw-dropping Arabian palace experience at a surprisingly competitive rate compared to peak Dubai.
hotels.standout: 1.3km private beach, 24k gold-flake cappuccinos, Michelin-starred Talea, and Mandarin Oriental's elevated service standards
hotels.watchOut: Enormous palace corridors mean long walks from rooms to pools and restaurants

hotels.name: Passalacqua
hotels.verdict: Crowned Best Boutique Hotel in the World — near-unanimous perfection across critics and guests alike.
hotels.standout: 18th-century terraced hillside villa with just 24 suites, vintage Riva boat rides, and the most enchanting Italian gardens on Lake Como
hotels.watchOut: Tiny 24-suite inventory books out 6–12 months ahead and seasonal closure runs Nov–Mar

hotels.name: Villa d'Este
hotels.verdict: The quintessential grand Italian lake palace — pure old-world Hollywood glamour.
hotels.standout: Renaissance 16th-century palace, legendary floating swimming pool on Lake Como, and 25 acres of manicured mosaic gardens
hotels.watchOut: Classic antique rooms and formal jacket-required evening dining feel old-school compared to Passalacqua

hotels.name: Hotel du Cap-Eden-Roc
hotels.verdict: The French Riviera's ultimate legend — unmatched coastal pool drama and Oetker service.
hotels.standout: Iconic cliff-carved saltwater infinity pool overlooking the Mediterranean, Dior Spa, and legendary French Riviera prestige
hotels.watchOut: Famously tough to reserve in summer (Cannes/July/Aug) and among Europe's priciest stays

hotels.name: Cheval Blanc Paris
hotels.verdict: Paris's reigning modern palace hotel, praised for breathtaking river views and culinary supremacy.
hotels.standout: Every room overlooks the Seine & Eiffel Tower, 3-Michelin-star Plénitude, and Paris's largest luxury hotel swimming pool (30m Dior Spa)
hotels.watchOut: Among the highest nightly rates in Paris — a true once-in-a-lifetime splurge

hotels.name: Claridge's
hotels.verdict: London's undisputed gold standard for timeless glamour and razor-sharp hospitality.
hotels.standout: Art Deco Mayfair perfection, brand-new subterranean spa & pool, world-famous afternoon tea, and effortless British butler charm
hotels.watchOut: Entry rooms are cozy by resort standards — upgrade to a Mayfair suite if space is your priority

hotels.name: The Connaught
hotels.verdict: Quietly considered by insiders as London's finest combination of gastronomy, cocktails, and discreet service.
hotels.standout: Three-Michelin-star Hélène Darroze, iconic tableside martinis at Connaught Bar, and London's only Aman Spa
hotels.watchOut: Intimate Mayfair village townhouse scale rather than sweeping lobby theatrics

hotels.name: Raffles London at The OWO
hotels.verdict: London's grandest new luxury landmark, drawing rave YouTube tours for its sheer architectural majesty.
hotels.standout: Churchill's restored Edwardian Old War Office, 9 restaurants (Mauro Colagreco), and Guerlain's spectacular 20m indoor pool
hotels.watchOut: Still settling into its huge multi-restaurant footprint — book Whitehall heritage suites for the full wow factor

hotels.name: The Gleneagles Hotel
hotels.verdict: Widely voted the UK's #1 luxury countryside resort — beloved by couples and families alike.
hotels.standout: 850-acre Scottish Highlands estate, 2-Michelin-star Restaurant Andrew Fairlie, championship golf, falconry, and magical breakfast hall
hotels.watchOut: Estate activities (shooting, spa, golf) add up quickly on top of room rates

hotels.name: Badrutt's Palace Hotel
hotels.verdict: The icon of Swiss alpine glamour — magical in winter snow and surprisingly serene in summer.
hotels.standout: Fairy-tale Engadin lake & snow-peak views, heated outdoor infinity pool in the snow, and legendary winter après-ski scene
hotels.watchOut: Peak winter season (Dec–Mar) commands astronomical rates and strict minimum stays

hotels.name: Amanzoe
hotels.verdict: Greece's ultimate architectural sanctuary — frequently rated among Europe's top 3 summer resorts.
hotels.standout: Acropolis-inspired marble pavilions with 360° Aegean views, private heated plunge pools, and a serene private-bay beach club
hotels.watchOut: 2.5-hour drive (or 25-min helicopter) from Athens; seasonal opening April–October

hotels.name: Canaves Ena & Epitome
hotels.verdict: Top-rated luxury escape on Santorini, dodging cruise-ship foot traffic while keeping iconic sunset views.
hotels.standout: Only property in Oia offering BOTH sunset & sea views from ultra-private black-volcanic pool villas — plus Hilton Honors points eligibility via SLH
hotels.watchOut: Set just above Ammoudi Bay (a 5-minute hotel shuttle from crowded Oia caldera streets)

hotels.name: Caruso, A Belmond Hotel
hotels.verdict: The Amalfi Coast's dreamiest honeymoon sanctuary with breathtaking cliffside views.
hotels.standout: 11th-century palazzo perched 350m above the Amalfi Coast with an infinity pool seemingly floating in the clouds + free boat excursions
hotels.watchOut: Winding cliff roads to Positano/Amalfi take patience — best savored at Ravello's relaxed hilltop pace

hotels.name: Aman New York
hotels.verdict: New York's most exclusive urban sanctuary — breathtaking spa and serenity if budget is no object.
hotels.standout: Functioning fireplaces in every Manhattan suite, three-story 25,000 sq ft Aman Spa with 20m indoor pool, and total hush above 5th Ave
hotels.watchOut: Eye-watering £1,800+/night starting price leads value-focused YouTubers to debate whether it beats The Peninsula or Carlyle

hotels.name: Four Seasons Resort Maui at Wailea
hotels.verdict: Hawaii's gold-standard luxury beach resort made globally famous by The White Lotus.
hotels.standout: Zero resort fee (rare in Hawaii!), iconic adults-only Serenity Infinity Pool, Spago by Wolfgang Puck, and complimentary outrigger canoeing
hotels.watchOut: Base resort-view rooms feel pricier than oceanfront upgrades — splurge for ocean view if visiting for a milestone

hotels.name: Amangiri
hotels.verdict: An architectural bucket-list phenomenon in the American Southwest desert.
hotels.standout: Monolithic concrete pool wrapped around a 165-million-year-old sandstone mesa, private via ferrata climbs, and Camp Sarika glamping
hotels.watchOut: Starting rates above £2,600/night (all-inclusive meals) make it one of North America's priciest stays

hotels.name: Post Ranch Inn
hotels.verdict: California's most romantic coastal retreat with jaw-dropping cliff views.
hotels.standout: Adults-only redwood treehouses & cliffside ocean suites 1,200ft above the Pacific, heated infinity basking pools, and Sierra Mar dining
hotels.watchOut: No TVs in rooms and Big Sur Highway 1 weather/road slides require flexible travel planning

hotels.name: The Beverly Hills Hotel
hotels.verdict: Old Hollywood magic kept spotless by Dorchester Collection's legendary service.
hotels.standout: Iconic banana-leaf wallpaper, legendary private bungalows, Polo Lounge power breakfasts, and underwater-music pool
hotels.watchOut: High Hollywood-glamour pricing for pool cabanas and dining

hotels.name: Rosewood Mayakoba
hotels.verdict: Consistently voted Mexico's #1 luxury beach resort for effortless service and family-or-couples versatility.
hotels.standout: Private boat check-in through emerald mangrove lagoons, heated plunge pools in every suite, and extraordinary butler warmth
hotels.watchOut: Seasonal sargassum seaweed can affect Riviera Maya beaches in summer months (resort clears daily)

hotels.name: One&Only Palmilla
hotels.verdict: Cabo's iconic grande dame with unmatched repeat-guest loyalty.
hotels.standout: One of the very few swimmable beaches in Los Cabos, Seared by Jean-Georges, and legendary welcome-home service
hotels.watchOut: Classic Hacienda style feels warmer and more traditional than ultra-modern Zadún or Montage nearby

hotels.name: Cheval Blanc St-Barth
hotels.verdict: Effortless French-Caribbean chic — the benchmark luxury beach address in St. Barths.
hotels.standout: The Caribbean's only official French Palace hotel, white-sand Flamands Beach, and La Case by Jean Imbert
hotels.watchOut: Tiny St. Barths airstrip arrival and ultra-luxury French Riviera pricing

hotels.name: Jade Mountain
hotels.verdict: One of the most visually arresting honeymoon hotels on the planet.
hotels.standout: 29 open-wall 'Sanctuaries' with glowing tile infinity pools staring straight at the UNESCO Piton peaks
hotels.watchOut: No air conditioning or glass fourth wall (natural hillside breezes + mosquito netting) and steep hilltop stairs

hotels.name: Amanyara
hotels.verdict: The Caribbean's premier ultra-luxury architectural retreat for snorkeling and privacy.
hotels.standout: Jean-Michel Gathy black-volcanic infinity pool bordering a pristine coral marine park and tranquil reflection ponds
hotels.watchOut: Remote northwest coast is 35 mins down rugged track from Grace Bay — pure isolated luxury

hotels.name: Four Seasons Resort Bora Bora
hotels.verdict: Widely considered Bora Bora's #1 overall luxury resort — the benchmark against which Westin & St. Regis are judged.
hotels.standout: Postcard-perfect Mount Otemanu views, inner coral lagoon sanctuary teeming with marine life, and freshly modernized overwater bungalows
hotels.watchOut: Steep resort dining and boat transfer fees (and no points redemption option unlike Westin or St. Regis)

hotels.name: The Brando
hotels.verdict: The ultimate eco-luxury private island sanctuary in the South Pacific.
hotels.standout: Marlon Brando's carbon-neutral private atoll reachable only by Air Tetiaroa private plane — 35 beachfront pool villas, all-inclusive fine dining & spa
hotels.watchOut: Strictly beachfront villas (no overwater bungalows) and ultra-exclusive £3,200+/night all-inclusive pricing

hotels.name: Conrad Bora Bora Nui
hotels.verdict: A favorite among points travelers seeking modern Hilton luxury with the best beach in Bora Bora.
hotels.standout: Longest stretch of private white-sand beach in Bora Bora, hilltop Hina Spa views, and huge Hilton Honors points value
hotels.watchOut: Faces the open ocean sunset rather than Mount Otemanu from most overwater villas (hilltop suites see the mountain)

hotels.name: Royal Mansour Marrakech
hotels.verdict: Unrivaled Moroccan craftsmanship and white-lace spa sanctuary — regularly ranked Africa's #1 city hotel.
hotels.standout: Every guest stays in a private 3-story Moroccan riad with rooftop plunge pool, serviced via hidden underground staff tunnels
hotels.watchOut: Ultra-exclusive pricing (nearly double La Mamounia) and formal palatial atmosphere

hotels.name: La Mamounia
hotels.verdict: Marrakech's most famous grand palace — intoxicating sensory luxury at a more accessible price than Royal Mansour.
hotels.standout: 17 acres of century-old royal gardens, Pierre Hermé pastries, Jean-Georges dining, and Churchill's legendary bar
hotels.watchOut: Busy public restaurants and day-pass visitors can make pool/lobby areas feel livelier than Royal Mansour

hotels.name: Singita Lebombo Lodge
hotels.verdict: The gold standard of modern African design-safari lodges with world-class conservation and wine cellars.
hotels.standout: Glass-walled cliffside suites cantilevered above the N'wanetsi River inside a 33,000-acre private Big Five concession
hotels.watchOut: All-inclusive ultra-luxury safari rates start over £2,200/night per suite — requires charter flight from Johannesburg

hotels.name: Giraffe Manor
hotels.verdict: One of the most joyful, once-in-a-lifetime wildlife hotel experiences on Earth.
hotels.standout: Endangered Rothschild's giraffes poke their heads straight through the manor's breakfast windows for morning treats
hotels.watchOut: Just 12 rooms mean booking 12–18 months in advance is essential; ideal as a 1–2 night Nairobi safari launchpad

hotels.name: One&Only Cape Town
hotels.verdict: Cape Town's liveliest 5-star resort-in-the-city with unbeatable Table Mountain backdrops.
hotels.standout: Freshly renovated Table Mountain suites, Africa's only Nobu, and a tranquil private spa island right beside V&A Waterfront
hotels.watchOut: Urban marina resort vibe rather than beachfront — pair with Clifton beaches or Winelands
